exposure: Intrapartum fetal heart rate monitoring method (Pinard stethoscope vs. Moyo continuous Doppler device)
outcome: Detection of abnormal fetal heart rate
cohort: 4082 low-risk pregnancies at a tertiary hospital
finding: Implementation of the Moyo continuous Doppler device for intrapartum fetal heart rate monitoring was associated with improved monitoring practices, increased detection of abnormal fetal heart rate, and more frequent and timely obstetric responses, although it also led to higher rates of cesarean and vacuum deliveries.
